failures.details: CDP touchEnd points identify the released finger, not the remaining finger. Corrected runner after event log confirmed the first finger was being ended.
Old evolution checker looked for S({/M({ source wrappers and returned zero. It now loads actual exported registries and verifies every target, learnset and PNG.

New input/safe-area code initially exceeded the unchanged budget. Minifier experiments increased size and were reverted. Single-source catalog identities/names reduce repeated data with all content retained.

limits: Safe insets are simulated using the same variables as real OS insets.
Native multi-touch and sprint use Chromium CDP; WebKit multi-pointer ownership uses synthetic events, ordinary capture/drag is real.
Earned sprint segment makes no uninterrupted/full-campaign or victory claim.
